completed.end: Hyun lists Weed at 50,000 won for one day, then sleeps.
CTS Media buys Weed for 3,090,000,000 won. Hyun verifies the money and shares the bankbook and hope with Grandmother. Stop before moving and hospital treatment.
Debt collectors take three billion won, return 90 million and the IOU, and leave after Han Jinsup’s five-year challenge. Stop before the three days of despair.

On the third day Hyun finds hope of earning again. Ninety million remains, fifty million is reserved for the house contract, forty million is available. He will not pay a cancellation penalty. Stops before registering for martial arts.
